Privacy

Privacy Policy

Starlink Customer Portal · starlink.preyone.com · Last updated 17 November 2026

Draft for review. This policy is pending final legal review by Preyone Enterprises (Pvt) Ltd.

1. Who we are

The Preyone Starlink Customer Portal is operated by Preyone Enterprises (Pvt) Ltd, Harare, Zimbabwe. You can reach us at support@preyone.com or +263 771 327 202.

2. What we collect

  • Account details: full name, email address, phone number and a password stored only as a salted hash.
  • Service details: Starlink kit serial numbers, nicknames, plan selection, data usage history and data credits.
  • Billing details: invoices, payment status, wallet balance and Preyone Payment payment references. We do not store mobile-money PINs or card numbers.
  • Technical data: sign-in times, session tokens and the request data needed to keep the portal secure.

3. How we use your data

  • To create and run your account and your Starlink service.
  • To show your plan, kit status, data usage and invoices.
  • To process payments and send receipts, billing notices and password-reset links.
  • To prevent fraud and abuse, and to keep the portal secure.

4. Payments

Payments are processed by Preyone Payment through EcoCash, InnBucks and Omari. Preyone receives only the payment status and reference needed to settle your invoice. Prices and balances are in US dollars.

5. Sharing

We do not sell your personal data. We share it only with service providers needed to run the portal (hosting, email delivery and payment processing), and where the law requires it.

6. Security and retention

Passwords are hashed, sessions are signed and expire, and reset links are valid for one hour. We keep account and billing records for as long as your account is active and for the period required by accounting rules.

7. Your choices

You can view and update your profile, change your password, and register or rename kits from the portal. To request access to, correction of, or deletion of your data, contact support@preyone.com.

8. Changes to this policy

We may update this policy. The date at the top shows when it last changed. Continued use of the portal after a change means you accept the updated policy.
